achievements.name: Welcome to Tau Ceti
achievements.description: Complete or skip your initial run.

steps: Start the game and begin your first run on Tau Ceti IV.
Either finish the initial run or skip it when prompted — either path unlocks the achievement.

achievements.name: This is Marathon
achievements.description: Experience shell death for the first time.

steps: Deploy a Shell into a run.
Die once (shell death) — the achievement unlocks on your first death.

achievements.name: Everything Runs on CyberAcme
achievements.description: Re-establish communication with the Sol system.

steps: Progress early story/faction work with CyberAcme.
Complete the priority contract that re-establishes communication with Sol (often tied to the "Welcome to Tau Ceti" contract chain).
Enter runs, gather loot, and reach an extraction point alive.
Successfully exfil 7 times total — failed runs do not count.
Deploy into runs with any Shell.
Complete 21 runs total — you do not need to exfil successfully; finishing/ending the run counts.
Fight UESC AI forces during runs.
Kill 147 UESC units across all runs — track naturally while looting and contracting.
Engage other player Runners in contested areas.
Secure 14 rival Runner eliminations across runs.
Open loot containers whenever you see them during runs.
Loot 777 containers total — prioritize dense POIs and contract routes.
Hunt elite UESC commander units (stronger than regular UESC infantry).
Eliminate 28 commanders across runs.
Accept faction contracts from the Factions/Contracts menus (multiple factions can be active).
Turn in 35 completed contracts total — progress is visible under each faction's Contracts section.
Open a Faction upgrade screen — capstones are the numbered circles (I–VI) at the bottom of each tree.
Unlock regular upgrades until a capstone fills (typically every 6 upgrades), then buy that capstone.
Repeat until you own 7 capstones total — they can be spread across different factions.

achievements.name: Reliable Asset
achievements.description: Reach VIP status with a faction.

steps: Pick one faction and focus reputation: contracts, runs, and combat XP for that faction.
Reach faction level 30 (VIP). Only one faction needs VIP — not all of them.
Use systems like C.A.R.R.I. if available to speed reputation gains.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: VIP is with a single faction, not every mega-corp — that makes the grind much more doable.

achievements.name: Seasoned Veteran
achievements.description: Earn 100 Season Levels in a single season.

steps: Play during one active season and earn Season XP from runs, contracts, and objectives.
Reach Season Level 100 before the season resets — progress does not carry across seasons.
warnings: Must be completed within a single season window.

achievements.name: Escape Will Make Me...
achievements.description: Complete all other achievements for Marathon.

steps: Unlock every other Marathon achievement first.
This meta-achievement unlocks automatically once the other 13 are complete.
